title: We've made the world too complicated
summary: A philosophical essay discussing how modern society has become unnecessarily complex, exploring the trade-offs between technological advancement and simplicity in everyday life.
problem_solved: Provokes reflection on whether we've over-engineered solutions to problems that had simpler answers before.
why_valuable: Offers a counterpoint to the constant push for more complexity in technology and society, suggesting that simplicity has inherent value.
